hooks.command: f=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *_espn_ext.py|*/tools/codegen/_generated/*|*/docs/docs/*/reference/*) echo 'BLOCKED: this is codegen output (# GENERATED -- DO NOT EDIT). Edit tools/codegen/endpoints/*.yaml or tools/codegen/templates/*, then run: uv run python tools/codegen/generate.py && uv run python tools/codegen/generate.py --check' >&2; exit 2;; esac; true

f=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null | tr '\\' '/'); case "$f" in */.superpowers/sdd/task-*) echo 'BLOCKED: flat SDD task artifact -- task-N-*.md names clobber across plans. Namespace it under a per-plan subdir: .superpowers/sdd/<plan-slug>/task-N-*.md (the shared progress.md ledger stays at the sdd/ root).' >&2; exit 2;; esac; true

c=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qiE 'co-authored-by:[[:space:]]*.*(claude|copilot|gpt|gemini|cursor)|generated with \[?claude|generated with claude' && { echo 'BLOCKED: AI co-author/attribution trailer detected. SDV rule: the human is the sole attributable contributor -- omit all Co-Authored-By / generated-with-AI trailers on commits and PRs.' >&2; exit 2; }; true

c=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qiE 'espn_capture_league|gen_returns_doc|crawl|for [a-z_]+ in .*(scoreboard|teams|summary)' && ! printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE 'limit|--max|--bound|head -|range\(' && echo 'NOTE: capture/crawl without a visible attempt bound -- cap attempts (not saves) to avoid a 404 flood (the CBS recruiting incident wasted 8,400+ requests).' >&2; true

c=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE 'git commit' && { s=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); printf '%s\n' "$s" | grep -qx 'uv.lock' && ! printf '%s\n' "$s" | grep -qx 'pyproject.toml' && echo 'NOTE: uv.lock is staged WITHOUT pyproject.toml -- uv run mypy/pytest silently re-locks uv.lock. Unintentional? git restore --staged uv.lock && git checkout uv.lock. Deliberate? commit it separately as chore(deps): re-lock.' >&2; }; true

c=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE 'git commit' && [ -f recipe/meta.yaml ] && { s=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); printf '%s\n' "$s" | grep -qx 'pyproject.toml' && ! printf '%s\n' "$s" | grep -qx 'recipe/meta.yaml' && echo 'NOTE: pyproject.toml is staged but recipe/meta.yaml is not -- if [project.dependencies] changed, mirror the dep into the recipe run requirements (a missing rapidfuzz broke conda builds twice). No dep change? ignore.' >&2; }; true

c=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE 'git push' && [ -f tools/codegen/generate.py ] && { r=$(git diff --name-only @{u}..HEAD 2>/dev/null || git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD 2>/dev/null); printf '%s\n' "$r" | grep -qE '(tools/codegen/|sportsdataverse/).*\.(py|yaml)$' && ! printf '%s\n' "$r" | grep -qE 'docs/docs/|sportsdataverse/parsed/' && echo 'NOTE: push range touches Python/codegen sources but contains NO regenerated outputs (docs/docs/ or sportsdataverse/parsed/) -- if any public function, docstring, or endpoint YAML changed, run the drift gate at the branch head first: uv run python tools/codegen/generate.py && uv run python tools/codegen/generate.py --check (CI fails on drift). Internal-only change? ignore.' >&2; }; true

c=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE 'git commit' && { for p in $(git diff --cached --name-only --diff-filter=A 2>/dev/null | grep -E '^tests/fixtures/.*\.(parquet|json|csv)$'); do d=$(dirname "$p"); [ -f "$d/README.md" ] || git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null | grep -qx "$d/README.md" || { echo "NOTE: fixture(s) added under $d with no README.md -- committed fixtures need a provenance README (source URL/wrapper, capture date, row counts, id dtypes, known gaps) per the fixtures convention." >&2; break; }; done; }; true

c=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE 'git commit' && b=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null) && { [ "$b" = "main" ] || [ "$b" = "master" ]; } && git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null | grep -qi 'sportsdataverse' && echo 'NOTE: committing directly on main in a sportsdataverse repo -- the convention is branch + PR (git switch -c <type>/<slug> first). Deliberate maintainer hotfix? proceed.' >&2; true

f=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null | tr '\\' '/'); case "$f" in *.py) [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; if [ -x .venv/Scripts/ruff.exe ]; then .venv/Scripts/ruff.exe format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; elif [ -x .venv/bin/ruff ]; then .venv/bin/ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; elif command -v ruff >/dev/null 2>&1; then ruff format "$f" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi;; esac; true

f=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *tools/codegen/endpoints/*.yaml|*tools/codegen/templates/*|*_espn_parsers.py|*tools/codegen/generate.py|*tools/codegen/spec.py) echo 'REMINDER: codegen source changed -> regenerate + verify: uv run python tools/codegen/generate.py && uv run python tools/codegen/generate.py --check' >&2;; esac; true

f=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in *tools/codegen/endpoints/*.yaml) { grep -q 'parser:' "$f" 2>/dev/null && ! grep -q 'returns_schema:' "$f" 2>/dev/null && echo 'REMINDER: an endpoint declares parser: but no returns_schema: -> add a tools/codegen/schemas/<name>.yaml with a col_name|type|description table (R-style types: integer/character/double/logical).' >&2; };; esac; true

f=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); case "$f" in */R/*.R) echo 'REMINDER (R): regenerate docs/NAMESPACE after editing R/ -> Rscript -e "devtools::document()" (and styler::style_pkg() if configured).' >&2;; esac; true

c=$(python -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('tool_input',{}).get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE 'git commit' && { h=$(git log -1 --oneline 2>/dev/null); n=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | grep -vc '^??'); echo "POST-COMMIT VERIFY: HEAD = [$h]; tracked files still modified/staged: $n. If HEAD is not the commit just made (or leftovers remain), a pre-commit hook (ruff-format / doctoc) rewrote files and silently ABORTED it -- re-git-add the rewritten files and re-commit; never --no-verify." >&2; }; true
